title: Thank you Pao for a fun tour!
text: Had a great time with Pao on the Segway tour - the teens loved it! Such a fun way to see Barcelona. Pao shared lots of great history and recommendations.

author: Swapnil_S

title: Great experience!
text:
We met Anton at the designated location. The vendor was actually very courteous, as we missed the original meeting due to a taxi issue and they were willing to reschedule for the next day. 
Anton trained us all on how to use the segways - which was actually very easy and intuitive (after a couple of minutes).
Next we went down to one side of the boardwalk, then to the other side, then across multiple locations in the city. Anton explained historical, cultural, and architectural topics in a very interesting way and had no problem answering our follow up questions.
